dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: As I thought, your branding is a sham...

dialogues.speaker: Hypermarket
dialogues.text: Th—This... I can't lose my branding just because of you...

dialogues.speaker: Hypermarket
dialogues.text: Wait! Do you need food? It doesn't matter who you are, surely you have some needs!

dialogues.speaker: Hypermarket
dialogues.text: Here, take these Matsutake Meat Rolls. See, I do have something you need here with me!

dialogues.speaker: Hypermarket
dialogues.text: This... This was food that I brought with me. There's only one of it, and it's free, so please, just leave me alone...

dialogues.speaker: Hypermarket
dialogues.text: Hello, you look like a traveler to me. Need to stock up on any essentials?

dialogues.speaker: Hypermarket
dialogues.text: We've got everything you could possibly think of in here, and more.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you sell artifacts?

dialogues.speaker: Hypermarket
dialogues.text: ...Ah, everything except those.

dialogues.speaker: Hypermarket
dialogues.text: Those you'd find in a museum or Cathedral... Hardly what you'd call 'essentials,' no?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you sell legendary weaponry?

dialogues.speaker: Hypermarket
dialogues.text: ...Ah, everything except that.

dialogues.speaker: Hypermarket
dialogues.text: Many travelers carry a run-of-the-mill sword or dagger on them, but not legendary weaponry... Are you sure you're just a regular traveler?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you sell poison?

dialogues.speaker: Hypermarket
dialogues.text: ...Ah, everything except that. I don't dare...

dialogues.speaker: Hypermarket
dialogues.text: That would never fly with the Millelith — or what, did you have some contacts you were planning on hooking me up with? Not just anyone can sell that stuff, you know...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Hypermarket
dialogues.text: Come again soon! Remember, we stock everything you could possibly think of — and more!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So much for 'everything I could possibly think of.'

dialogues.speaker: Hypermarket
dialogues.text: B—But... I said 'essentials'! If you class those as essential then I'm not sure what to say...

dialogues.speaker: Hypermarket
dialogues.text: Anyway, I sell things that by most people's definition would fall under 'travel essentials.'

dialogues.speaker: Hypermarket
dialogues.text: You've piqued my curiosity though. What exactly does your journey entail?
